body.statement:
If \(U_1,U_2,\ldots\) are i.i.d. bounded random vectors with mean \(\mu\) and covariance \(\Omega\), then
\[
\sqrt n(\overline U_n-\mu)\Rightarrow\mathcal N(0,\Omega).
\]
If \(f\) is continuously differentiable at \(\mu\), then
\[
\sqrt n\{f(\overline U_n)-f(\mu)\}\Rightarrow
\mathcal N\!\left(0,Df(\mu)\Omega Df(\mu)^{\mathsf T}\right).
\]

source.locator: Section 3.1, central-limit and differentiable-map steps used in Theorems 3.1--3.2
source.verbatim_statement: Asymptotic normality of θ̂ then results from the central limit theorem applied to ∑ᵢ φ(zᵢ)/√n, with asymptotic variance given by the variance of φ(z).

attestation.note: Literal sentence transcribed from the primary Handbook chapter scan, printed page 2142; notation was normalized. The differentiable-map specialization is instantiated in Theorem 3.2, printed page 2145.
